cold_day_night.explain: Days where both afternoon and night were unusually cold.
cold_day_night.name: Cold days + cold nights

cold_heavy_rain.explain: Unusually cold days with extreme rainfall.
cold_heavy_rain.name: Cold + extreme rain

dry_cold.explain: Days both unusually cold and dry.
dry_cold.name: Cold + dry days

dry_hot.explain: Days both extremely hot and dry — drought-heat combos that stress crops and power grids.
dry_hot.name: Hot + dry days

warm_day_night.explain: Days where both afternoon and night were unusually hot — no overnight relief.
warm_day_night.name: Hot days + warm nights

warm_heavy_rain.explain: Extremely hot days with extreme rainfall — the worst flash-flood setup.
warm_heavy_rain.name: Hot + extreme rain

wet_cold.explain: Days both unusually cold and rainy.
wet_cold.name: Cold + rainy days

wet_hot.explain: Days both extremely hot and rainy — tropical downpours in heat.
wet_hot.name: Hot + rainy days

CDD.explain: Most consecutive days with under 1mm rain — the drought number.
CDD.name: Longest dry spell

PRCPTOT.explain: Total rain for the whole year.
PRCPTOT.name: Yearly rainfall

R10mm.explain: Days with 10mm or more — solid downpours.
R10mm.name: Heavy rain days

R1mm.explain: Days with at least 1mm of rain.
R1mm.name: Rainy days

R20mm.explain: Days with 20mm or more — the kind that floods streets.
R20mm.name: Very heavy rain days

R95p.explain: Total rain falling on the wettest 5% of days. Grows when extremes intensify.
R95p.name: Very wet days total

R99p.explain: Total rain on the wettest 1% of days — the rarest deluges.
R99p.name: Extremely wet days total

RX1day.explain: The most rain falling in a single day each year — the flash-flood number.
RX1day.name: Heaviest downpour

RX5day.explain: The most rain in any 5 consecutive days — the river-flood number.
RX5day.name: Heaviest 5-day rain

SDII.explain: Average rain per rainy day. Rises when rain comes in harder bursts.
SDII.name: Rain intensity

CSDI.explain: Days in cold snaps — 6+ consecutive days of unusual cold.
CSDI.name: Coldwave days

DTR.explain: Average difference between afternoon high and night low. Shrinks when nights warm faster than days.
DTR.name: Day-night swing

FD.explain: Nights below 0°C. Rare in Thailand outside high mountains.
FD.name: Frost nights

ID.explain: Days that never get above 0°C. Virtually absent in Thailand.
ID.name: Ice days

SU.explain: Days hotter than 25°C. Counts how long summer-like heat lasts each year.
SU.name: Summer days

TN10p.explain: Share of nights colder than 90% of nights in 1961–1990.
TN10p.name: Cold nights

TN90p.explain: Share of nights warmer than 90% of nights in 1961–1990.
TN90p.name: Warm nights

TNn.explain: The coldest nighttime low of the year.
TNn.name: Coldest night

TNx.explain: The warmest nighttime low of the year. High TNx means nights don't cool down — the dangerous part of heatwaves.
TNx.name: Warmest night

TR.explain: Nights warmer than 20°C — nights with no relief from heat.
TR.name: Tropical nights

TX10p.explain: Share of days with unusually cool afternoons (cooler than 90% of days in 1961–1990). Shrinking as the climate warms.
TX10p.name: Cool days

TX90p.explain: Share of days with unusually hot afternoons (hotter than 90% of days in 1961–1990).
TX90p.name: Hot days

TXn.explain: The coldest afternoon temperature of the year. Rising TXn means winters are losing their coldest days.
TXn.name: Coldest day

TXx.explain: The hottest afternoon temperature of the year. Rising TXx means more intense heat peaks.
TXx.name: Hottest day

WSDI.explain: Days in heatwaves — 6+ consecutive days of unusual heat.
WSDI.name: Heatwave days
